Basic chat completion via the GitHub Copilot provider (gpt-4o) with a single user message

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"github_copilot/gpt-4o\",\"temperature\":0}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chat(request)
    println(result)
}
```
